correctness.rationale: Genus-three Riemann-Hurwitz, F5 odd-degree cubic-bijection, even Hasse-Weil numerator and genus-three reciprocal symmetry prove the exact polynomial shape and common elliptic factor for every smooth centered quartic. The actual enclosed Python checker enumerates all 125 triples and checks squarefreeness twice, counts F25 points through two different field representations and character/direct root methods, and asserts exactly eleven frequencies summing to 100. Reduction mod 5 gives rank 0 or 2; matches independently the published divisor condition. No finite experiment is used to prove the universal odd-degree or functional-equation claims.

value.rationale: A complete Weil-isogeny stratification of the natural normalized Picard genus-three family over the smallest field of characteristic five is a precise and reusable arithmetic invariant. It refines the known rank-zero/rank-two split into eleven distinct isogeny classes, identifies a universal supersingular elliptic isogeny factor, and determines all extension-field counts by a single exact finite census. Not an arbitrary slice or a routine reformatting of an existing table.
